headlines.headline: Futures steady: S&P 500 E-minis +6.75 pts (+0.09%) at ~5:25 AM ET, Dow +31 pts (+0.06%), Nasdaq 100 E-minis +1.75 pts (+0.01%) — markets waiting on Mideast diplomacy and Thursday's Trump-Xi summit.
headlines.why_it_matters: Tight, wait-and-see tape — no index-level news in the overnight session, so the open will hinge on tonight's Connect keynote buzz and any summit headlines rather than macro data.

headlines.headline: First high-level US-Iran meeting since June held on UNGA sidelines: envoy Witkoff said mediators shuttled with Iranian FM Araghchi and Trump said they had 'a very good meeting'; oil fell on the news. Separately, Iran's Fars News denied the Kyodo report that Tehran offered to reopen Hormuz within 7 days, and Trump said a deal won't come until after November midterms.
headlines.why_it_matters: The peace-premium unwind is now event-driven, not rumor-driven — oil toward a sixth down session is the macro fuel for the tech bid. But the 7-day Hormuz offer is single-source, unconfirmed — treat as fragile.

headlines.headline: Xi expected in Washington today for a Sept 23–25 state visit; the White House meeting is Thursday Sept 24. Agenda: trade-truce extension (expires Nov 10), tariff cuts on non-sensitive goods, an AI incident-notification 'red phone,' critical minerals, Taiwan arms sales, Boeing orders. Trump meets CEOs of GM, Meta, Apple, Amazon and Tesla today.
headlines.why_it_matters: The summit is increasingly framed as a status-quo ceremony, not a breakthrough — that lowers both upside-catalyst risk and disappointment risk for Thursday; today's CEO meetings keep megacap optics in focus.

headlines.headline: Meta Connect today: Zuckerberg keynote at 7pm ET (official agenda: AI, AI glasses, VR); Barron's calls it a must-watch for the Muse trade — investors want usage metrics and Muse Spark model updates. Options price a ±4.5% move into end of week. Stock is +20% since Muse's Sept 8 launch (App Store #1, 2.5M US downloads in 2 weeks).
headlines.why_it_matters: Tonight is the week's defining catalyst for the Muse trade — usage and roadmap reveals can extend or deflate the AI-adoption rally; the options market is braced for a real swing. Earnings backdrop: Q2 2026 costs grew ~2x revenue growth and FCF fell to $784M — adoption has to outrun the spending math.

headlines.headline: Reuters (Sept 22): Meta is testing a 'human concierge' — human contractors handling some Muse phone-call errands; internal posts show employees raised privacy concerns; Meta says it's a feedback test that won't roll out publicly without disclosures. 404media independently reported the same test Sept 22; no official confirmation.
headlines.why_it_matters: A second press report weakens the single-source discount but it's still unconfirmed — a trust-and-privacy counterweight to the Muse momentum going into tonight's keynote; single-source, unconfirmed — treat as fragile.

headlines.headline: Stifel upgraded Microsoft to Buy from Hold on Tuesday, PT raised to $575 from $530 (~15%+ upside) — thesis: durable AI growth, cost discipline, model-agnostic Azure strategy, easing margin concerns. Oppenheimer also lifted its PT to $570 (Outperform). Shares closed -0.7% Tuesday but recovered +0.3% overnight amid Xbox layoff reports.
headlines.why_it_matters: Back-to-back analyst upgrades on margin discipline and Azure re-acceleration broaden the AI-hyperscaler narrative beyond Meta/AMD — a sentiment tailwind for the cloud trade. Earnings backdrop: FQ4 (ended June 30) revenue $90B +18%, operating income $40.6B +18%.

headlines.headline: Nvidia closed Tuesday +0.66% at $228.18 — a sixth straight gain (52-wk high $236.54). Carried: SpaceX committed to Nvidia exclusively on its Aug 4 call — building AI infrastructure entirely on the Vera Rubin architecture, targeting 2 GW of compute by end-2026 and ~10 GW by late 2027.
headlines.why_it_matters: Six green sessions plus a locked-in hyperscale customer underline that AI-compute demand still has no demand problem — support for the chip leg of the AI trade, though tomorrow's Trump-Xi summit could reopen the China-sales question. Earnings backdrop: Aug 26 beat — revenue $46.7B (+56% vs $46.2B est), EPS $1.05 vs $1.01, Q3 guide $54B ±2%.

headlines.headline: Tesla 'Semi Rollout' event tomorrow (Sept 24) at the Sparks, NV factory — invite-only with factory tours and ride-alongs; plant sized for 50,000 trucks/year, though the line has run since April and Musk warned the ramp will be 'very slow.' Largest confirmed order: Einride's 500 trucks.
headlines.why_it_matters: Ceremonial rather than a launch (production since April) — a brand-and-execution showcase for the commercial-EV story; cautious ramp expectations keep the bar low for a positive read.

headlines.headline: Amazon blocked Meta's Muse AI agent from shopping and checkouts on amazon.com (Bloomberg, Sept 21) — Amazon protecting retail margin against agent-driven disintermediation.
headlines.why_it_matters: The opening shot in the agent-vs-platform war: platforms tax or block agents to protect margin and ad revenue — this boundary defines how the market judges Muse's commerce story. Earnings backdrop: Q2 revenue $200.61B, EPS $5.75 (beat), AWS +37% YoY to $42.2B, fastest in 18 quarters.
